title: Assuring's hand-written technical records each fill exactly one slot
when: Reads the spec at the commit under test with the pinned lathe check --json, and lists each technical record of ST-ASR whose kind is accidental, that no tooling record generates and that nothing provides, with the fills that start from it.
then: Expects each such record to fill exactly one slot of ST-PAT-GO-CODE, and names each record of ST-ASR that fills none, two or a slot of another pattern.

title: Assuring's fills each serve an essential record
when: Reads the findings accidental-not-accounted-for of the pinned lathe check --json on the spec at the commit under test, for each hand-written technical record of ST-ASR.
then: Expects no such finding for a fill of ST-ASR: each fill builds, implements, meets, persists, links to or sits under an essential record as the check counts it. Names each fill that serves none.
notes: The test number is the domain's position in the product (ST-ASR 1 to ST-SUP 8). The test runs the pinned Lathe check once per test binary and reads its structured output, so it adds no second reading of the spec. The check is the one count of what serves an essential record, so the test and the coverage never differ. Not automated yet: the check names fills of ST-ASR that serve no essential record (tooling and an entry point of ST-ASR; generators, library files and tooling of ST-SUP). The test function holds no subtest for this record until they are accounted for, because a test that fails on main is not a proof.

title: Assuring's tests give the same outcome on a workstation as in CI
when: Runs each suite command that holds tests of ST-ASR on a developer's workstation, as an unprivileged user, in a network namespace whose only routes are loopback and the network of the local services that the suite starts, with KUBECONFIG unset, no kube configuration file, and no CI provider token, registry credential or cloud credential in the environment, at the commit under test, and reads the outcome of each test ID of ST-ASR.
then: Expects each test ID that proves an obligation of ST-ASR to have an outcome, with the same result as the CI run of the same commit. Expects no test of ST-ASR to be skipped or to fail because a cluster, a hosted service, a credential or a route out is missing, and names each test that is.
notes: Not automated yet. The test number is the domain's position (ST-ASR 1 to ST-SUP 8), as for the tests of ST-PAT-GO-CODE. A missing outcome is a fault, not a pass. The tests of ST-ASR that need the hosted CI provider's API for the proof run and the release decision use a fake of the hosted CI provider's API that answers from fixed records, as the tests of qualify-compiler-release.py use a fake gh.
